paite: Huchi in David in heutu leh makai chiteng, sangte leh zate heutute toh thu akikum uhi.
heading: Kiriath-jearim A Kipan Pathian Bawm Lakna / (2 Sam 6.1-11)
english: David consulted with the captains of thousands and of hundreds, even with every leader.

paite: David in Israel kikhawmte tengteng kiang ah, "Hoih na sak ua, TOUPA i Pathian ua kipan ahihleh, mun chiteng a Israel gam tengteng nutsiat a om i unaute kiang ah thu i khak ding ua, loupa munte nei akhopite ua akiang ua siampute leh Levi mite om, huchi a i kiang a ahong kikhopkhawm theihna ding un.
english: David said to all the assembly of Israel, “If it seems good to you, and if it is of Yahweh our God, let’s send word everywhere to our brothers who are left in all the land of Israel, with whom the priests and Levites are in their cities that have pasture lands, that they may gather themselves to us.

paite: Huchi in i Pathian uh bawm i lakik nawn ding uhi; Saul hun lai in i na zong kei uhi," achi hi.
english: Also, let’s bring the ark of our God back to us again, for we didn’t seek it in the days of Saul.”

paite: Kikhawmpi tengteng in huchibang in i hih ding uh achi ua: mi tengteng mit ah huai thil dik ahi ngal a.
english: All the assembly said that they would do so, for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.

paite: Huchi in David in Israel tengteng Aigupta gam luita Shihor a kipan Hamath lutna chiang pha in, Kiriath- jearim a kipan a Pathian bawm va la ding in amite akaikhawm hi.
english: So David assembled all Israel together, from the Shihor River of Egypt even to the entrance of Hamath, to bring God’s ark from Kiriath Jearim.

paite: Huchi in David, Israel tengteng toh, Baalah huai bel, Kiriath-jearim ah ahi, huai tuh Judah gam ahi a, huai a kipan a Pathian, TOUPA Cherubte tung a tupa, aminlohna om va la ding in akuantou hi.
english: David went up with all Israel to Baalah, that is, to Kiriath Jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up from there God Yahweh’s ark that sits above the cherubim, that is called by the Name.

paite: Pathian bawm kangtalai thak in apua ua, Abinadab inn a kipan alakhia ua: huchi in Uzza leh Ahio in ahawl uhi.
english: They carried God’s ark on a new cart, and brought it out of Abinadab’s house; and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.

paite: Huchi in David leh Israel tengteng Pathian ma ah ahatna tengteng un late, kaihgingte, pekging gui sawm neite, khuangtate, dakkhutbette leh pengkulte toh lopna bawl in a-om uhi.
english: David and all Israel played before God with all their might, even with songs, with harps, with stringed instruments, with tambourines, with cymbals, and with trumpets.

paite: Huan Chidon buhchilna phual ahong tun un, bawngtalte akisuih man un, Uzza in bawm len ding in akhut in asawk hi.
english: When they came to Chidon’s threshing floor, Uzza put out his hand to hold the ark, for the oxen stumbled.

paite: Uzza tung ah TOUPA hehna asouta a, bawm a akhut akhoih ziak in, amah ahihlumta hi: huchi in Pathian ma ah asita hi.
english: Yahweh’s anger burned against Uzza, and he struck him because he put his hand on the ark; and he died there before God.

paite: TOUPA Uzza tung a apuahkhap ziak in, David alungkim kei hi: huchi in huai lai tuni tan in, Perez-uzzah achita hi.
english: David was displeased, because Yahweh had broken out against Uzza. He called that place Perez Uzza, to this day.

paite: Huai ni in David in Pathian akihta a, bangchi in Pathian bawm inn ka kitun thei dia? chi in.
english: David was afraid of God that day, saying, “How can I bring God’s ark home to me?”

paite: Huchi in ama'n akiang a, David khopi sung ah bawm apolut kei a, Git mi Obed-edom insung ah apolut zawta hi.
english: So David didn’t move the ark with him into David’s city, but carried it aside into Obed-Edom the Gittite’s house.

paite: Pathian bawm bel kha thum Obed-edom inkote kiang ah insung ah a-om a: huchi in TOUPA'N Obed-edom leh aneih tengteng avualzawlta hi.
english: God’s ark remained with the family of Obed-Edom in his house three months; and Yahweh blessed Obed-Edom’s house and all that he had.
